Verify your batch
 

Five steps from raw material
to your door.

All inside the USA. Nothing ships until a batch clears the full 14-day safety panel.

 
Sourcing & raw material testing
APIs from US FDA-certified facilities, tested in our USA facilities for toxins, heavy metals and purity.
Preparation & sterilization
Raw materials are sterilized and prepared into compounds, with clean handling through to the lyo cycle.
Manufacturing & freeze-drying
Made and freeze-dried in our South Carolina facility, then sent to our seal and crimp division.
Quality & safety testing
Each batch is held through a 14-day panel for endotoxins, mold, bacteria and metals before release.
Secure shipping
Sealed, labeled and tracked from our facility to your door, by standard or overnight delivery.

Even the vials are made in the USA.

From freeze-drying in South Carolina to the final seal and crimp, every lot stays in one domestic process chain, with no offshore handoff mid‑batch.

Every lot is screened for

Heavy metals
Confirmed within specified limits on every lot.
 
Toxins
Sterility and endotoxin checked before release.
 
Impurities
Residual solvents verified within limits.
